_about: The token tree build_tokens.py turns into tokens.json. dropbox.com's public surface declares two token layers: the generated DIG layer (--dig-*, resolved on the painted dig-Theme-vis2023--bright scope for 'light' and the declared-but-unpainted vis2023--dark scope for 'dark') and the dwg-component layer (--DWG__TEMP__color__* brand palette in 'core', rebound per painted section as --dwg-theme__color__* roles in 'light.dwg.coconut|graphite|navy'). Scales (spacing, type, radius, motion, breakpoints, font stacks) are declared var leaves in 'core'; measured computed styles add the real control heights, focus rings, painted radii and transition values.
